name: How long does a typical window jamb repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window jamb repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window jamb repair varies depending on the extent of the damage and the type of window. A minor repair, such as patching a small area of rot, might take a few hours. More extensive damage requiring partial jamb replacement and custom fitting could take a full day or longer, especially if multiple jambs are affected. Factors like weather conditions for exterior work or the need for specialized materials can also influence the timeline. During our initial consultation, we provide an estimated timeframe for your specific project in the Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, or Kuna area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Window jamb repair can take a few hours for minor issues or a full day for extensive damage, depending on the scope and window type.
